caption: The drawing depicts a decorative stand or frame set against a plain, light beige background. The stand consists of a central, rectangular frame colored in light gray, angled slightly to the left. This rectangular frame is supported by an ornate base and two side brackets that curve upward in a wave-like design. The two side brackets and the arched top are a muted pink color, with coiled, circular decorations resembling flowers or rosettes at the top corners. The base of the stand, as well as the rear right-side support, are in shades of dull yellow or tan, with the front featuring a relief or carved motif that appears leaf-like in shape. The object is centered on the page with a large amount of unmarked background space around it, and there are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Missal Stand
